scope.scenario: Chapter 04 aircraft and the Chapter 07 scenario, including 128 rpm collidable propellers.
scope.perPlayer: One local dynamic aircraft and one live kinematic peer replica per headless worker. One pair per flight lane.
scope.relay: The actual Space WebSocket relay forwards poses. The replica uses the production interpolation and pose-application code, with serverDesiredRunState set to running for the leased aircraft.
scope.terrain: Nature coordinates, airborne path with no terrain chunks loaded. No GUI or GPU rendering.
scope.timing: 500 fixed steps at the target 20 Hz. Observed time includes coordinator work, IPC to three pilot groups, the all-worker barrier and outgoing WebSocket enqueue.
scope.cpu: Average occupied cores and percent are collected from the sandbox benchmark client cgroup. The relay is recorded separately.
scope.nativeVerification: Compatibility integration and contact-solving entry points are armed to fail the test. Exact Rapier step counts validated every tick. Native root, hub and decoration colliders checked after the first step; pair/propeller contact counts use Rapier contact callbacks.

comparison.explanation: Same 96-aircraft scenario, CPU allocation, WebSocket relay and time window. Prior tests dispatched to the compatibility solver. The new Rapier backend routes live replicas to the native kinematic path.
